title: Daily
description: Levels that only appear as the daily challenge, from easy on Mondays to nasty edge cases at the weekend.

levels.title: One more pixel
levels.description: The design team wants the box one pixel wider. Make it 10px.
levels.hint: <C-a> adds one to the number under the cursor, or to the next number on the line.

levels.title: Teh classic
levels.description: Fix the typo before anyone notices.
start_text: Fix teh typo before anyone notices

value: Fix the typo before anyone notices

levels.hint: Jump to the e with fe, then xp swaps two letters.

levels.title: Dead code
levels.description: Nothing runs after a return. Move the print above it.
levels.hint: ddp swaps a line with the one below it.

levels.title: Semicolon season
levels.description: The linter wants a semicolon at the end of every line.
levels.hint: Append once with A;<Esc>, then j. repeats it on the next line.

levels.title: Caps lock strikes
levels.description: Someone left caps lock on. Fix the greeting and leave the rest alone.
levels.hint: ~ flips the case of a character, and a count flips that many.

levels.title: The whole path
levels.description: Replace the file path with notes.md. A word stops at the slash; a WORD doesn't.
levels.hint: cW changes up to the next space, slashes and dots included.

levels.title: Outer bracket
levels.description: Land on the closing bracket of the outer condition. You don't have to be on a bracket to start.
levels.hint: % jumps to the match of the bracket under the cursor, or of the next one on the line.

levels.title: Whole words only
levels.description: Jump to the next total: not totals, not total_tax.
levels.hint: * searches for the word under the cursor, as a whole word.

levels.title: Hug the bracket
levels.description: Join the call onto one line, with no space after the bracket.
levels.hint: J joins the lines and leaves the cursor on the space it added.

levels.title: Quote unquote
levels.description: Change the greeting to hi. You don't need to reach the quotes first.
levels.hint: ci" works from anywhere before the quotes on the line.

levels.title: One word too many
levels.description: Drop please, and the space before it.
levels.hint: At the end of a line, daw takes the space before the word instead.

levels.title: Cat person
levels.description: This sentence was written by a dog person. Make every cat a dog, and leave the chase alone.
start_text: the cat saw a cat chase a cat

value: the dog saw a dog chase a dog

levels.hint: :s/cat/dog/g replaces every match on the line.

levels.title: Collect the keepers
levels.description: Put the first and third lines in register a, in that order.
levels.hint: Yanking into an uppercase register, "A, adds to register a instead of replacing it.

levels.title: Excitement
levels.description: That was close. Five exclamation marks close.
levels.hint: A count before an insert types the text that many times.

levels.title: Not so blank
levels.description: Go to the next real paragraph break. A line of spaces isn't one.
levels.hint: } stops only at truly empty lines.

levels.title: The last two letters
levels.description: Fix the typo at the very end of the line.
levels.hint: At the end of a line, x moves the cursor back, so xp swaps nothing. xP does.

levels.title: Alphabet soup
levels.description: Sort the shopping list.
levels.hint: Ex commands can be shortened: :sor is :sort.

levels.title: Ten comes after nine
levels.description: Sort by the numbers, smallest first.
levels.hint: Plain :sort compares text, so 10 comes before 9. :sort n compares numbers.

levels.title: Brackets everywhere
levels.description: Put every number in square brackets.
levels.hint: In a :s replacement, & is the whole match.

levels.title: Quote them all
levels.description: Turn the list into strings for an array: quotes around each word, a comma after.
levels.hint: In a :s replacement, & is the whole match, so .* can wrap a whole line.

levels.title: Mind the gaps
levels.description: Delete every blank line.
levels.hint: :g runs a command on every line that matches: ^$ matches an empty one.

levels.title: Stop shouting
levels.description: Nobody needs to read this in capitals. Make the whole line lowercase.
levels.hint: V selects the line, and u makes a selection lowercase.

levels.title: Copy that
levels.description: The chores list needs this one twice.
levels.hint: yy copies the line and p puts it below.

levels.title: One l too many
levels.description: Fix the greeting. You can start from the end.
levels.hint: X deletes the character before the cursor.

levels.title: Drop the clause
levels.description: Keep only the part after the comma.
levels.hint: A WORD runs to the next space, comma included: d2W deletes two of them.

levels.title: The middle argument
levels.description: Remove b, and the comma and space that come with it.
levels.hint: From b, dW deletes up to the next WORD.

levels.title: More than one
levels.description: There's more than one file. Make it plural.
levels.hint: 3e lands on the end of the third word, and a appends after it.

levels.title: Shout the error
levels.description: Make the first word all capitals, and only that word.
levels.hint: gU uppercases over a motion: gUe up to the end of the word.

levels.title: Null and void
levels.description: Drop the comparison and keep the condition.
levels.hint: t= stops just before the =, and dt) deletes up to the bracket.

levels.title: Empty the list
levels.description: Clear the list but keep its brackets.
levels.hint: di[ only works on or inside the brackets, so get there first with f[.

levels.title: Look back
levels.description: Jump to where total was set, two lines up.
levels.hint: # searches backwards for the word under the cursor.

levels.title: Fill in the title
levels.description: Copy the name into the title.
levels.hint: W skips name: as one WORD. Yank the word, go down, and put it after the space.

levels.title: Every other line
levels.description: Delete every line that says drop.
levels.hint: :g/pattern/d deletes every line that matches. The pattern only has to tell the lines apart.

levels.title: Title case
levels.description: Capitalise every word of the headline.
levels.hint: ~ flips a letter and steps past it, so w takes you to the next word.

levels.title: Breathing room
levels.description: Put a space on each side of every =.
levels.hint: :%s runs a substitution on every line.

levels.title: One sentence less
levels.description: Delete the middle sentence and its space.
start_text: One. Delete this one. Keep this.
levels.hint: das deletes a sentence and the space after it.

levels.title: Hidden spaces
levels.description: End every line with a semicolon. Careful: some lines end in spaces you can't see, and they must go.
levels.hint: A appends after the hidden spaces. :%s/ *$/;/ replaces any spaces at the end of a line, or none, with a semicolon.

levels.title: Inverted caps
levels.description: Every letter has the wrong case. Fix them all.
levels.hint: g~~ flips the case of the whole line.

levels.title: The dot remembers
levels.description: Keep only the two KEEPs.
start_text: one two KEEP three four KEEP
levels.hint: . repeats the last change with its count: d2w, then . deletes two more words.

levels.title: The fox goes last
levels.description: Move fox to the end of the line, with one space before it and none after.
levels.hint: dw takes the word and its space. Put it after a new space at the end, then tidy up.

levels.title: The second number
levels.description: Add one to y, not x.
levels.hint: <C-a> works on the first number from the cursor on, so start from the end.

levels.title: Below zero
levels.description: Take the offset down to minus one.
levels.hint: <C-x> takes a count, and numbers can go below zero.
